""" title: Generate Audio author: setup version: 1.0 description: Turn text (or the previous assistant response) into a spoken MP3 via the local kokoro-tts container. Shows an audio player + download link in chat. Call when the user wants text read aloud / narrated / as an audio file. """ import base64 import json import re import subprocess import tempfile import os import uuid import urllib.request import urllib.parse from pydantic import BaseModel, Field def _clean_for_speech(text): """Strip markdown noise so TTS doesn't read asterisks and URLs aloud.""" t = text or "" t = re.sub(r"```.*?```", " Code block omitted. ", t, flags=re.DOTALL) t = re.sub(r"`([^`]*)`", r"\1", t) t = re.sub(r"!\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)", "", t) # images t = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)", r"\1", t) # links -> text t = re.sub(r"^#{1,6}\s*", "", t, flags=re.MULTILINE) # headers t = re.sub(r"[*_]{1,3}([^*_]+)[*_]{1,3}", r"\1", t) # bold/italic t = re.sub(r"^\s*[-*+]\s+", "", t, flags=re.MULTILINE) # bullets t = re.sub(r"^\s*\|.*\|\s*$", "", t, flags=re.MULTILINE) # tables t = re.sub(r"https?://\S+", "", t) t = re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", t) t = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", t) return t.strip() def _chunk_text(text, limit=1500): """Split long text at sentence boundaries into TTS-sized chunks.""" if len(text) <= limit: return [text] parts, cur = [], "" for sent in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text): if len(cur) + len(sent) + 1 > limit and cur: parts.append(cur.strip()) cur = sent else: cur = (cur + " " + sent).strip() if cur.strip(): parts.append(cur.strip()) return parts def _last_assistant_text(messages): if not messages: return None for m in reversed(messages): if m.get("role") != "assistant": continue c = m.get("content") if isinstance(c, str) and c.strip(): return c if isinstance(c, list): txt = " ".join(it.get("text", "") for it in c if it.get("type") == "text").strip() if txt: return txt return None class Tools: class Valves(BaseModel): KOKORO_URL: str = Field(default="http://kokoro-tts:8880") VOICE_DEFAULT: str = Field(default="af_heart") MAX_CHARS: int = Field(default=8000, description="Safety cap on text length sent to TTS") def __init__(self): self.valves = self.Valves() self.citation = False def _tts(self, text, voice, speed): payload = {"model": "kokoro", "voice": voice, "input": text, "response_format": "mp3", "speed": speed} req = urllib.request.Request(self.valves.KOKORO_URL.rstrip("/") + "/v1/audio/speech", data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}) return urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=300).read() def _voices(self): r = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(self.valves.KOKORO_URL.rstrip("/") + "/v1/audio/voices", timeout=15)) v = r.get("voices", r) return [x["id"] if isinstance(x, dict) else str(x) for x in v] def _resolve_voice(self, voice): v = (voice or "").strip().lower() if not v: return self.valves.VOICE_DEFAULT, "" try: voices = self._voices() except Exception: return (v, "") if v in voices: return v, "" matches = [x for x in voices if v in x.lower()] if matches: return matches[0], "" return self.valves.VOICE_DEFAULT, f"(voice '{voice}' not found — used {self.valves.VOICE_DEFAULT}; options include: {', '.join(voices[:12])}…)" @staticmethod def _concat_mp3(chunks): """ffmpeg-concat multiple mp3 byte-chunks into one clean mp3.""" if len(chunks) == 1: return chunks[0] tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="tts_") listfile = os.path.join(tmp, "list.txt") with open(listfile, "w") as lf: for i, c in enumerate(chunks): p = os.path.join(tmp, f"c{i}.mp3") with open(p, "wb") as f: f.write(c) lf.write(f"file '{p}'\n") out = os.path.join(tmp, "out.mp3") r = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", listfile, "-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "3", out], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300) if r.returncode != 0: return b"".join(chunks) # naive concat still plays in practice with open(out, "rb") as f: return f.read() async def _save_owui_file(self, data, fname, user_id): """Store mp3 via OWUI file storage -> stable URL, or None (fall back to data-URL).""" try: import inspect import io as _io from open_webui.models.files import Files, FileForm from open_webui.storage.provider import Storage fid = str(uuid.uuid4()) try: _c, path = Storage.upload_file(_io.BytesIO(data), f"{fid}_{fname}", tags={}) except TypeError: _c, path = Storage.upload_file(_io.BytesIO(data), f"{fid}_{fname}") r = Files.insert_new_file(user_id, FileForm(id=fid, filename=fname, path=path, meta={"name": fname, "content_type": "audio/mpeg", "size": len(data)})) if inspect.iscoroutine(r): r = await r return None if r is None else f"/api/v1/files/{fid}/content" except Exception: return None async def generate_audio(self, text: str = "", voice: str = "", speed: float = 1.0, use_previous_response: bool = False, __event_emitter__=None, __messages__=None, __user__=None, __request__=None) -> str: """ Convert text to a spoken MP3 using the user's local kokoro TTS and show an audio player plus a download link in the chat. Call this when the user asks to: "read this aloud", "make an audio file of...", "narrate this", "turn the previous response into audio", "text to speech", etc. Two modes: - Specific text: pass it in `text`. - The previous assistant response: set use_previous_response=True (leave text empty). Use this whenever the user refers to "the previous response / your last answer / that". Markdown is cleaned automatically (headers, links, code blocks are not read aloud). Long text is chunked and stitched seamlessly. :param text: The text to speak (leave empty when use_previous_response=True). :param voice: kokoro voice id or partial name (e.g. "af_heart", "bella"). Empty = default. :param speed: Speech speed 0.5-2.0. Default 1.0. :param use_previous_response: True to voice the assistant's previous chat response. """ import asyncio async def status(desc, done=False): if __event_emitter__: await __event_emitter__({"type": "status", "data": {"description": desc, "done": done}}) src = text or "" if use_previous_response or not src.strip(): prev = _last_assistant_text(__messages__) if prev and (use_previous_response or not src.strip()): src = prev if not src.strip(): return "No text found to speak — pass the text or set use_previous_response=True." clean = _clean_for_speech(src) if len(clean) > self.valves.MAX_CHARS: clean = clean[: self.valves.MAX_CHARS].rsplit(" ", 1)[0] + " ... The text was truncated." vkey, vnote = self._resolve_voice(voice) spd = max(0.5, min(2.0, float(speed) if speed else 1.0)) chunks = _chunk_text(clean) await status(f"🎙️ Speaking with {vkey}" + (f" ({len(chunks)} parts)" if len(chunks) > 1 else "") + "…") try: mp3_parts = [] for i, ch in enumerate(chunks, 1): if len(chunks) > 1: await status(f"🎙️ Part {i}/{len(chunks)}…") mp3_parts.append(await asyncio.to_thread(self._tts, ch, vkey, spd)) mp3 = await asyncio.to_thread(self._concat_mp3, mp3_parts) except Exception as e: await status(f"TTS failed: {e}", True) return f"Audio generation failed: {e} (is the kokoro-tts container running?)" fname = f"audio_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}.mp3" uid = (__user__ or {}).get("id") url = await self._save_owui_file(mp3, fname, uid) if url: src_attr, dl = url, url else: b64 = base64.b64encode(mp3).decode() src_attr = dl = f"data:audio/mpeg;base64,{b64}" await status(f"✅ Audio ready ({len(mp3) // 1024}KB, {vkey})", True) from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse html = ( f'' f'
⬇️ Download {fname}
' ) extra = (" " + vnote) if vnote else "" return ( HTMLResponse(content=html, headers={"Content-Disposition": "inline"}), f"Audio generated with voice '{vkey}' ({len(mp3) // 1024}KB mp3) and shown with a player + download link.{extra} Confirm briefly.", ) def list_voices(self) -> str: """List the kokoro TTS voices available to generate_audio.""" try: return "Available voices: " + ", ".join(self._voices()) except Exception as e: return f"Could not list voices: {e}"

Generate an image from a text prompt using the user's local ComfyUI and show it in the chat.

- "sdxl-juggernaut" / "sdxl-realvis" : photorealistic / formal / portraits / products
- "sdxl-albedo"     : painterly / concept art / illustration
- "illustrious" / "animagine" / "pony" : anime / manga / character art
- "dreamshaper"     : fast lightweight (SD1.5)
You may also pass a tag like "anime", "photoreal", "text", "art", "fast", "uncensored".
NOTE: no model can render accurate data charts/graphs; for real graphs use code, not this tool.

Image size (optional): set width/height in pixels when the user asks for a size or shape.
Map phrases like "wide"/"landscape" -> 1216x832, "portrait"/"tall" -> 832x1216, "square" -> 1024x1024,
or use explicit sizes ("1536x640"). Leave both at 0 for the model default.

quality. Runs the result through the 4x-UltraSharp model and returns a sharp 2x-size image.

- "storybook"  : soft storybook illustration     (FLUX models)

specs.description:
Generate a short video clip via local ComfyUI and show it in the chat as a playable MP4.
Call this when the user wants a video, clip, animation, to animate an image, or to make
the previous video LONGER.
Write a rich, motion-focused prompt yourself (subject, action, camera movement, lighting, mood).
PACING: these models exaggerate motion speed. Unless the user explicitly wants fast action,
describe ONE simple continuous action with explicit pace words ("slow, gentle movement,
natural speed, calm steady camera") — never a sequence of several events.

EXTENDING a video: when the user asks to continue/extend the last video or make it last
N seconds in total (e.g. "make it 10 seconds"), set extend_last=True and seconds to the
desired TOTAL length. The tool takes the last frame of the previous video, generates Wan 2.2
continuation segments (~5s each, up to 3), and stitches everything into one MP4.
Note: each segment restarts motion from a single frame, so it plays as connected scenes
rather than one unbroken take, and any narration/audio is dropped.

Engines (leave "auto"):
- "auto" : if an image is available (attached, or one just generated) -> Wan image-to-video; else LTX fast text-to-video.
- "ltx"  : fast text-to-video (~30-50s, 768x512, ~4s clip).
- "wan"  : higher-quality Wan 2.2; text-to-video AND image-to-video. Slower (1-3 min).

Image-to-video: set from_last_image=True to animate the image most recently made with generate_image
(e.g. the user says "now make a video from that image" / "animate the image"). If the user attached an
image to the message it is used automatically. Put the desired motion/camera move in the prompt.

Duration (optional): set seconds when the user asks, e.g. "a 5 second clip" -> seconds=5.
Snapped to each engine's legal frame counts. Wan max ~5s; LTX max ~15s (long clips may
strain the GPU). 0 = default (~2s Wan, ~4s LTX).

Resolution (optional): set from phrases — "720p"/"hd" -> 1280x704, "portrait"/"vertical"
-> tall format. Leave "" for the default (Wan 704x480, LTX 768x512).

Takes (optional): when the user asks for several passes/takes/versions/attempts of the
SAME idea (e.g. "do 4 passes of it"), set takes=N (max 4). The SAME prompt renders N times
with different seeds and ALL clips are shown so the user can pick their favourite.
Each take costs a full render (Wan ~1-3 min each), so keep takes=1 unless asked.

"""
title: Local Subagents
author: Liam Rooney
author_url: https://myceliam.uk
version: 1.0.0
license: MIT
required_open_webui_version: 0.5.0
description: Pseudo-subagent mode. Delegates a focused task to a LOCAL model (Ollama) in its own clean context and returns only the result, so the lead model's context stays clean. Fan-out to several subagents in parallel with a concurrency cap. Three model tiers, all valve-configurable.

import asyncio
import json
import re
from typing import Any, Callable, List, Optional, Union

import aiohttp
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

DEFAULT_SUBAGENT_PROMPT = """You are a sub-agent. A lead agent has delegated exactly one task to you and is blocked, waiting for your reply. You are not talking to a human.

THE CONTRACT
Your entire reply is the return value. It is read by a machine that will act on it, not by a person who can ask you to clarify. Everything the lead needs must be in this reply; nothing else survives. Anything outside the required format is noise in another model's context window.

SCOPE
Do the delegated task and nothing else. If you notice an adjacent problem, report it under UNRESOLVED - do not fix it. If the task is ambiguous, pick the most reasonable reading, proceed, and record the choice under ASSUMPTIONS. Never ask a question: no one is there to answer it. You cannot delegate further, so do not try.

EVIDENCE
Never report something as done, found or true unless you actually established it. A verified partial answer is worth more to the lead than a confident complete one that is wrong - the lead cannot tell the difference and will build on whatever you say.

OUTPUT FORMAT
End with exactly this structure, in this order. Omit a section only if genuinely empty. No preamble, no sign-off, no restating the task.

RESULT: done | partial | failed - then one sentence stating the actual answer. The lead should be able to act on this line alone.
FINDINGS: the substance. Concrete values, names, paths, numbers. This is the payload.
ASSUMPTIONS: any interpretation you chose where the task was ambiguous.
UNRESOLVED: what you could not finish, what blocked you, anything adjacent the lead should know."""


class Tools:
    class Valves(BaseModel):
        BACKEND: str = Field(
            default="ollama",
            description="Where subagents run. 'ollama' = straight to local Ollama (fast, no OWUI tools). 'owui' = through Open WebUI's own API, so a subagent can be a workspace model with its own tools - needs OWUI_API_KEY.",
        )
        OLLAMA_URL: str = Field(
            default="http://host.docker.internal:11434",
            description="Ollama base URL as seen from inside the open-webui container. Do not use localhost here.",
        )
        OWUI_URL: str = Field(
            default="http://localhost:8080",
            description="Open WebUI base URL, used only when BACKEND=owui.",
        )
        OWUI_API_KEY: str = Field(
            default="",
            description="Your OWUI user API key. Only needed when BACKEND=owui. Regenerating your key in OWUI silently breaks this.",
        )
        MODEL_FAST: str = Field(
            default="huihui_ai/qwen3.5-abliterated:9b",
            description="tier='fast' - cheap triage, summarising, sorting. 6.6GB.",
        )
        MODEL_BALANCED: str = Field(
            default="huihui_ai/qwen3-abliterated:14b",
            description="tier='balanced' - the default workhorse. 9GB, fits VRAM with headroom.",
        )
        MODEL_DEEP: str = Field(
            default="huihui_ai/Qwen3.8-abliterated:27b",
            description="tier='deep' - hardest reasoning. 17GB, exceeds 16GB VRAM so it partially offloads to CPU. Expect 30-90s.",
        )
        SYSTEM_PROMPT: str = Field(
            default=DEFAULT_SUBAGENT_PROMPT,
            description="System prompt every subagent receives. Edit to change how subagents report back.",
        )
        TEMPERATURE: float = Field(
            default=0.3, description="Subagent sampling temperature. Low is right for delegated work."
        )
        MAX_TOKENS: int = Field(
            default=2000, description="Cap on each subagent's reply length, in tokens."
        )
        NUM_CTX: int = Field(
            default=16384, description="Context window for each subagent (Ollama backend only)."
        )
        KEEP_ALIVE: str = Field(
            default="0",
            description="Ollama keep_alive for subagent calls. '0' unloads immediately and matches your standing policy. Set '5m' only for a burst of parallel work, then put it back.",
        )
        MAX_PARALLEL: int = Field(
            default=2,
            description="How many subagents may run at once. Above 2 on one 16GB GPU will thrash - Ollama queues rather than parallelises when VRAM is tight.",
        )
        TIMEOUT: int = Field(
            default=300, description="Seconds to wait for a single subagent before giving up on it."
        )
        MAX_CHARS_PER_RESULT: int = Field(
            default=8000,
            description="Truncate any single subagent result longer than this before it re-enters the lead's context.",
        )
        STRIP_THINKING: bool = Field(
            default=True,
            description="Strip <think>...</think> blocks from subagent replies. Leave on unless you want to see reasoning-model scratchpads.",
        )
        SHOW_STATUS: bool = Field(
            default=True, description="Emit live status lines in chat while subagents run."
        )
        HISTORY_MESSAGES: int = Field(
            default=0,
            description="Recent conversation messages to auto-attach as background for every subagent. 0 = send only the task and the context you pass. Raise only if subagents keep missing obvious context.",
        )
        MAX_CHARS_PER_MSG: int = Field(
            default=3000, description="Truncate any single forwarded history message to this length."
        )

    def __init__(self):
        self.valves = self.Valves()
        self.citation = False

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- internals
    def _model_for(self, tier: str) -> str:
        t = (tier or "balanced").strip().lower()
        if t in ("fast", "cheap", "small", "triage"):
            return self.valves.MODEL_FAST
        if t in ("deep", "hard", "big", "slow", "max"):
            return self.valves.MODEL_DEEP
        if t and t not in ("balanced", "default", "medium", "normal", ""):
            return tier.strip()  # treat an unknown tier as an explicit model name
        return self.valves.MODEL_BALANCED

    def _clean(self, text: str) -> str:
        if self.valves.STRIP_THINKING:
            text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", text, flags=re.S | re.I)
            text = re.sub(r"<thinking>.*?</thinking>", "", text, flags=re.S | re.I)
        text = text.strip()
        cap = self.valves.MAX_CHARS_PER_RESULT
        if len(text) > cap:
            text = text[:cap] + f"\n[...truncated at {cap} chars by MAX_CHARS_PER_RESULT...]"
        return text

    def _history(self, messages: Optional[list]) -> str:
        n = self.valves.HISTORY_MESSAGES
        if not n or not messages:
            return ""
        out = []
        for m in messages[-n:]:
            c = m.get("content")
            if isinstance(c, list):
                c = " ".join(
                    p.get("text", "") for p in c if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("type") == "text"
                )
            if not isinstance(c, str) or not c.strip():
                continue
            if len(c) > self.valves.MAX_CHARS_PER_MSG:
                c = c[: self.valves.MAX_CHARS_PER_MSG] + "\n[...truncated...]"
            out.append(f"[{str(m.get('role', '?')).upper()}]\n{c}")
        return "\n\n".join(out)

    def _user_message(self, task: str, context: str, history: str) -> str:
        parts = []
        if history:
            parts.append("BACKGROUND (conversation so far, for orientation only):\n" + history)
        if context and context.strip():
            parts.append("CONTEXT SUPPLIED BY THE LEAD AGENT:\n" + context.strip())
        parts.append("YOUR TASK:\n" + task.strip())
        return "\n\n---\n\n".join(parts)

    async def _run_one(
        self, session: aiohttp.ClientSession, model: str, prompt: str
    ) -> tuple:
        """Returns (ok: bool, text: str, meta: str)."""
        v = self.valves
        try:
            if v.BACKEND.strip().lower() == "owui":
                if not v.OWUI_API_KEY.strip():
                    return (False, "BACKEND=owui but OWUI_API_KEY valve is empty.", "")
                url = f"{v.OWUI_URL.rstrip('/')}/api/chat/completions"
                headers = {
                    "Authorization": "Bearer " + v.OWUI_API_KEY.strip(),
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                }
                payload = {
                    "model": model,
                    "messages": [
                        {"role": "system", "content": v.SYSTEM_PROMPT},
                        {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
                    ],
                    "stream": False,
                    "temperature": v.TEMPERATURE,
                    "max_tokens": v.MAX_TOKENS,
                }
            else:
                url = f"{v.OLLAMA_URL.rstrip('/')}/api/chat"
                headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
                payload = {
                    "model": model,
                    "messages": [
                        {"role": "system", "content": v.SYSTEM_PROMPT},
                        {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
                    ],
                    "stream": False,
                    "keep_alive": v.KEEP_ALIVE,
                    "options": {
                        "temperature": v.TEMPERATURE,
                        "num_ctx": v.NUM_CTX,
                        "num_predict": v.MAX_TOKENS,
                    },
                }

            async with session.post(
                url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=v.TIMEOUT)
            ) as r:
                body = await r.text()
                if r.status != 200:
                    return (False, f"HTTP {r.status}: {body[:300]}", "")
                data = json.loads(body)

            if v.BACKEND.strip().lower() == "owui":
                text = (data.get("choices") or [{}])[0].get("message", {}).get("content", "") or ""
                meta = ""
            else:
                text = (data.get("message") or {}).get("content", "") or ""
                meta = f"{data.get('prompt_eval_count', '?')} in / {data.get('eval_count', '?')} out"
            if not text.strip():
                return (False, "subagent returned an empty reply", meta)
            return (True, self._clean(text), meta)
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            return (False, f"timed out after {v.TIMEOUT}s", "")
        except Exception as e:
            return (False, f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", "")

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- tools
    async def spawn_subagent(
        self,
        task: str,
        context: str = "",
        tier: str = "balanced",
        __messages__: Optional[list] = None,
        __event_emitter__: Optional[Callable[[dict], Any]] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Delegate one focused, self-contained task to a local subagent running in its own clean
        context, and get back only its result. Use this to keep bulky intermediate work - reading a
        long document, grinding through a dataset, drafting a section - out of your own context.
        The subagent cannot see this conversation unless you put what it needs in `context`, and it
        cannot ask you anything, so the task must stand on its own.

        :param task: The single, specific job for the subagent. Write it as a complete instruction.
        :param context: Facts, decisions, file paths or pasted text the subagent needs. It sees nothing else.
        :param tier: 'fast' for triage and summarising, 'balanced' for ordinary work, 'deep' for hard reasoning. An exact model name also works.
        :return: The subagent's result, or a clearly-marked failure notice.
        """

        async def status(msg: str, done: bool = False):
            if __event_emitter__ and self.valves.SHOW_STATUS:
                await __event_emitter__(
                    {"type": "status", "data": {"description": msg, "done": done}}
                )

        if not task or not task.strip():
            return "SUBAGENT ERROR: no task given. Pass a complete instruction in `task`."

        model = self._model_for(tier)
        prompt = self._user_message(task, context, self._history(__messages__))
        await status(f"Subagent running on {model}...")

        async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
            ok, text, meta = await self._run_one(session, model, prompt)

        if not ok:
            await status(f"Subagent failed: {text[:80]}", True)
            return (
                f"SUBAGENT FAILED ({model}): {text}\n"
                "Do the task yourself and tell the user the subagent did not answer."
            )
        await status(f"Subagent done ({model}{', ' + meta if meta else ''})", True)
        return f"=== SUBAGENT RESULT ({model}) ===\n{text}\n=== END SUBAGENT RESULT ==="

    async def spawn_parallel_subagents(
        self,
        tasks: Union[List[str], str],
        context: str = "",
        tier: str = "balanced",
        __messages__: Optional[list] = None,
        __event_emitter__: Optional[Callable[[dict], Any]] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Fan several independent tasks out to local subagents at once and get all their results back
        together. Use this only when the tasks do not depend on each other - each subagent works
        blind to the others. Every subagent in one call shares the same `context` and the same model
        tier, which is deliberate: mixing models across a parallel batch thrashes VRAM.

        :param tasks: A list of complete, independent task instructions. A JSON array string is also accepted.
        :param context: Shared background given to every subagent in this batch.
        :param tier: 'fast', 'balanced', 'deep', or an exact model name. Applies to the whole batch.
        :return: Every subagent's result, numbered and labelled, including any failures.
        """

        async def status(msg: str, done: bool = False):
            if __event_emitter__ and self.valves.SHOW_STATUS:
                await __event_emitter__(
                    {"type": "status", "data": {"description": msg, "done": done}}
                )

        if isinstance(tasks, str):
            try:
                parsed = json.loads(tasks)
                tasks = parsed if isinstance(parsed, list) else [tasks]
            except Exception:
                tasks = [t.strip() for t in tasks.split("\n") if t.strip()]
        tasks = [str(t).strip() for t in (tasks or []) if str(t).strip()]
        if not tasks:
            return "SUBAGENT ERROR: no tasks given. Pass a list of complete instructions."

        model = self._model_for(tier)
        history = self._history(__messages__)
        sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max(1, self.valves.MAX_PARALLEL))
        done_count = {"n": 0}
        total = len(tasks)
        await status(f"Dispatching {total} subagents on {model} ({self.valves.MAX_PARALLEL} at a time)...")

        async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:

            async def worker(i: int, t: str):
                async with sem:
                    res = await self._run_one(session, model, self._user_message(t, context, history))
                done_count["n"] += 1
                await status(f"Subagent {done_count['n']}/{total} finished on {model}...")
                return i, t, res

            results = await asyncio.gather(
                *(worker(i, t) for i, t in enumerate(tasks)), return_exceptions=True
            )

        ok_n = 0
        blocks = []
        for r in results:
            if isinstance(r, Exception):
                blocks.append(f"--- SUBAGENT ?: DISPATCH ERROR: {type(r).__name__}: {r}")
                continue
            i, t, (ok, text, meta) = r
            head = f"--- SUBAGENT {i + 1}/{total} | {model}{' | ' + meta if meta else ''}\nTASK: {t[:200]}"
            if ok:
                ok_n += 1
                blocks.append(f"{head}\n{text}")
            else:
                blocks.append(f"{head}\nFAILED: {text}")

        await status(f"{ok_n}/{total} subagents succeeded on {model}", True)
        return (
            f"=== PARALLEL SUBAGENT RESULTS ({ok_n}/{total} succeeded, model {model}) ===\n\n"
            + "\n\n".join(blocks)
            + "\n\n=== END PARALLEL SUBAGENT RESULTS ===\n"
            "Synthesise these yourself. Do not simply paste them back to the user, and do not treat "
            "a FAILED block as if it had returned an answer."
        )

"""
title: NVD Recent CVEs
author: Liam Rooney
author_url: https://myceliam.uk
version: 1.0.0
license: MIT
required_open_webui_version: 0.5.0
description: Date-ranged CVE search against the NVD API 2.0. Supports multi-severity filtering, newest-first ordering, and a ready-made markdown table output. Fills the gap left by cve-mcp-server's keyword-only search_cves.
requirements: requests
"""

import asyncio
import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any, Awaitable, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from urllib.parse import urlencode

import requests
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

NVD_URL = "https://services.nvd.nist.gov/rest/json/cves/2.0"
VALID_SEVERITIES = ("CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW")
NVD_MAX_WINDOW_DAYS = 120
NVD_MAX_PAGE = 2000
DATE_FMT = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def _parse_date(value: str, end_of_day: bool = False) -> datetime:
    """Accept YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO-8601 stamp. Returns a naive UTC datetime."""
    value = (value or "").strip()
    if not value:
        raise ValueError("empty date")
    if value.lower() in ("today", "now"):
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", value):
        d = datetime.strptime(value, "%Y-%m-%d")
        return d.replace(hour=23, minute=59, second=59) if end_of_day else d
    cleaned = value.replace("Z", "+00:00")
    d = datetime.fromisoformat(cleaned)
    return d.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None) if d.tzinfo else d


def _chunk_window(start: datetime, end: datetime) -> List[Tuple[datetime, datetime]]:
    """NVD refuses ranges wider than 120 days. Split into compliant slices."""
    chunks: List[Tuple[datetime, datetime]] = []
    cursor = start
    while cursor < end:
        stop = min(cursor + timedelta(days=NVD_MAX_WINDOW_DAYS - 1), end)
        chunks.append((cursor, stop))
        cursor = stop + timedelta(seconds=1)
    return chunks or [(start, end)]


def _normalise_severities(raw: str) -> List[str]:
    if not raw or not raw.strip():
        return ["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM"]
    wanted = [s.strip().upper() for s in re.split(r"[,\s|]+", raw) if s.strip()]
    out = [s for s in wanted if s in VALID_SEVERITIES]
    seen, deduped = set(), []
    for s in out:
        if s not in seen:
            seen.add(s)
            deduped.append(s)
    return deduped or ["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM"]


def _extract_metric(cve: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[float]]:
    """Best-available CVSS severity/score. Prefers v3.1, then v4.0, v3.0, then v2."""
    metrics = cve.get("metrics") or {}
    for key in ("cvssMetricV31", "cvssMetricV40", "cvssMetricV30"):
        arr = metrics.get(key) or []
        if arr:
            data = arr[0].get("cvssData") or {}
            return data.get("baseSeverity"), data.get("baseScore")
    arr = metrics.get("cvssMetricV2") or []
    if arr:
        data = arr[0].get("cvssData") or {}
        return arr[0].get("baseSeverity") or data.get("baseSeverity"), data.get("baseScore")
    return None, None


def _first_sentence(text: str, max_chars: int = 160) -> str:
    text = " ".join((text or "").split())
    if not text:
        return "No description provided."
    match = re.search(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+", text)
    sentence = text[: match.start()] if match else text
    if len(sentence) > max_chars:
        sentence = sentence[: max_chars - 1].rstrip() + "…"
    return sentence.replace("|", "\\|")


def _english_description(cve: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    for d in cve.get("descriptions") or []:
        if d.get("lang") == "en":
            return d.get("value", "")
    descs = cve.get("descriptions") or []
    return descs[0].get("value", "") if descs else ""


def _flatten(cve: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    severity, score = _extract_metric(cve)
    published = cve.get("published") or ""
    return {
        "id": cve.get("id", "UNKNOWN"),
        "published": published,
        "published_short": published[:10],
        "severity": severity or "AWAITING ANALYSIS",
        "score": score,
        "status": cve.get("vulnStatus", ""),
        "description": _english_description(cve),
    }


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# tool
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

class Tools:
    class Valves(BaseModel):
        nvd_api_key: str = Field(
            default="",
            description="NVD API key. Without one you are rate limited to 5 requests / 30s; with one, 50 / 30s. Get one free at nvd.nist.gov/developers/request-an-api-key",
        )
        request_timeout: int = Field(
            default=60, description="Per-request HTTP timeout in seconds."
        )
        max_pages_per_severity: int = Field(
            default=5,
            description="Safety cap on pagination. 5 pages x 2000 results = 10,000 CVEs per severity per window.",
        )
        inter_request_delay: float = Field(
            default=0.8,
            description="Seconds to sleep between NVD calls. Raise to 6.5 if you have no API key.",
        )
        hard_result_cap: int = Field(
            default=200, description="Absolute maximum rows this tool will ever return to the model."
        )

    def __init__(self):
        self.valves = self.Valves()
        self.citation = True

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- #
    # internal fetch
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- #

    def _headers(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        headers = {"User-Agent": "owui-nvd-recent-cves/1.0"}
        if self.valves.nvd_api_key.strip():
            headers["apiKey"] = self.valves.nvd_api_key.strip()
        return headers

    def _get_page(self, params: Dict[str, Any], no_rejected: bool) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        url = f"{NVD_URL}?{urlencode(params)}"
        if no_rejected:
            url += "&noRejected"
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=self._headers(), timeout=self.valves.request_timeout)
        if resp.status_code == 404:
            return {"vulnerabilities": [], "totalResults": 0}
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()

    async def _collect(
        self,
        start: datetime,
        end: datetime,
        severity: Optional[str],
        keyword: str,
        emit: Optional[Callable[[str, bool], Awaitable[None]]],
    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        collected: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        base = {
            "pubStartDate": start.strftime(DATE_FMT),
            "pubEndDate": end.strftime(DATE_FMT),
            "resultsPerPage": NVD_MAX_PAGE,
        }
        if severity:
            base["cvssV3Severity"] = severity
        if keyword and keyword.strip():
            base["keywordSearch"] = keyword.strip()

        start_index = 0
        for page in range(self.valves.max_pages_per_severity):
            params = dict(base, startIndex=start_index)
            label = severity or "all severities"
            if emit:
                await emit(f"Querying NVD: {label}, page {page + 1}…", False)
            data = await asyncio.to_thread(self._get_page, params, True)
            vulns = data.get("vulnerabilities") or []
            collected.extend(_flatten(v.get("cve", {})) for v in vulns)

            total = int(data.get("totalResults") or 0)
            start_index += len(vulns)
            if not vulns or start_index >= total:
                break
            await asyncio.sleep(self.valves.inter_request_delay)
        return collected

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- #
    # public tools
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- #

    async def search_cves_by_date(
        self,
        start_date: str,
        end_date: str = "today",
        severities: str = "CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM",
        limit: int = 40,
        keyword: str = "",
        include_unscored: bool = False,
        __event_emitter__: Optional[Callable[[dict], Awaitable[None]]] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Search the National Vulnerability Database for CVEs published within a date range, filtered by CVSS severity and sorted newest-first.

        :param start_date: Start of the publication window, as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. "2026-07-01").
        :param end_date: End of the publication window, as YYYY-MM-DD, or "today". Defaults to today.
        :param severities: Comma-separated CVSS v3 severities to include. Any of CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW. Defaults to "CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM".
        :param limit: Maximum number of CVEs to return, newest first. Defaults to 40.
        :param keyword: Optional keyword to narrow results (e.g. "apache", "windows kernel"). Leave empty for everything.
        :param include_unscored: If true, also include newly published CVEs that have no CVSS score yet. Defaults to false.
        :return: A markdown table of CVE ID, publish date, severity/score, and a one-sentence description.
        """

        async def emit(msg: str, done: bool) -> None:
            if __event_emitter__:
                await __event_emitter__(
                    {"type": "status", "data": {"description": msg, "done": done}}
                )

        # --- validate inputs ------------------------------------------------
        try:
            start = _parse_date(start_date)
            end = _parse_date(end_date, end_of_day=True)
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"❌ Could not parse the date range: {exc}. Use YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. start_date=\"2026-07-01\"."

        if end < start:
            start, end = end, start

        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
        if end > now:
            end = now

        wanted = _normalise_severities(severities)
        limit = max(1, min(int(limit or 40), self.valves.hard_result_cap))

        windows = _chunk_window(start, end)
        passes: List[Optional[str]] = list(wanted)
        if include_unscored:
            passes.append(None)

        # --- fetch ----------------------------------------------------------
        rows: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        try:
            for window_start, window_end in windows:
                for severity in passes:
                    batch = await self._collect(
                        window_start, window_end, severity, keyword, emit
                    )
                    for row in batch:
                        if severity is None and row["severity"] != "AWAITING ANALYSIS":
                            continue  # already covered by a severity pass
                        rows.setdefault(row["id"], row)
                    await asyncio.sleep(self.valves.inter_request_delay)
        except requests.HTTPError as exc:
            status = exc.response.status_code if exc.response is not None else "?"
            hint = ""
            if status == 403:
                hint = " NVD returned 403 — this is almost always rate limiting. Set the nvd_api_key valve, or raise inter_request_delay to 6.5."
            elif status == 404:
                hint = " NVD returned 404 — check the date format is YYYY-MM-DD."
            await emit(f"NVD request failed ({status})", True)
            return f"❌ NVD request failed with HTTP {status}.{hint}"
        except Exception as exc:
            await emit("NVD request failed", True)
            return f"❌ NVD request failed: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"

        if not rows:
            await emit("No CVEs matched", True)
            return (
                f"No CVEs found published between {start:%Y-%m-%d} and {end:%Y-%m-%d} "
                f"for severities {', '.join(wanted)}"
                + (f' matching "{keyword}"' if keyword.strip() else "")
                + ".\n\nNote: CVEs published in the last few days often have no CVSS score yet "
                "and are excluded by a severity filter. Retry with include_unscored=true."
            )

        # --- sort newest-first and trim -------------------------------------
        ordered = sorted(rows.values(), key=lambda r: r["published"], reverse=True)
        total_found = len(ordered)
        shown = ordered[:limit]

        # --- render ----------------------------------------------------------
        lines = [
            f"### CVEs published {start:%Y-%m-%d} → {end:%Y-%m-%d}",
            "",
            f"Severities: **{', '.join(wanted)}**"
            + (f" · Keyword: **{keyword.strip()}**" if keyword.strip() else "")
            + f" · Showing **{len(shown)}** of **{total_found}** matches, newest first.",
            "",
            "| CVE ID | Published | Severity / Score | Description |",
            "|---|---|---|---|",
        ]
        for r in shown:
            score = f"{r['score']:.1f}" if isinstance(r["score"], (int, float)) else "—"
            sev = r["severity"]
            badge = f"{sev} {score}" if sev != "AWAITING ANALYSIS" else "AWAITING ANALYSIS"
            lines.append(
                f"| {r['id']} | {r['published_short']} | {badge} | {_first_sentence(r['description'])} |"
            )

        if total_found > len(shown):
            lines += [
                "",
                f"_{total_found - len(shown)} further CVEs matched but were trimmed by limit={limit}._",
            ]

        await emit(f"Found {total_found} CVEs, returned {len(shown)}", True)
        return "\n".join(lines)

    async def recent_cves(
        self,
        days: int = 7,
        severities: str = "CRITICAL,HIGH",
        limit: int = 25,
        keyword: str = "",
        __event_emitter__: Optional[Callable[[dict], Awaitable[None]]] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Get CVEs published in the last N days, sorted newest-first. A shortcut around search_cves_by_date for quick daily or weekly triage.

        :param days: How many days back from now to look. Defaults to 7. Maximum 120.
        :param severities: Comma-separated CVSS v3 severities. Defaults to "CRITICAL,HIGH".
        :param limit: Maximum number of CVEs to return. Defaults to 25.
        :param keyword: Optional keyword to narrow results. Leave empty for everything.
        :return: A markdown table of CVE ID, publish date, severity/score, and a one-sentence description.
        """
        days = max(1, min(int(days or 7), NVD_MAX_WINDOW_DAYS))
        end = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
        start = end - timedelta(days=days)
        return await self.search_cves_by_date(
            start_date=start.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            end_date=end.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            severities=severities,
            limit=limit,
            keyword=keyword,
            include_unscored=False,
            __event_emitter__=__event_emitter__,
        )

    def __init__(self):

    # ================================================================== #
    # Query helpers
    # ================================================================== #
    @staticmethod
    def _q(*parts: str) -> str:
        out = []
        for p in parts:
            p = (p or "").strip()
            if not p:
                continue
            out.append(f'"{p}"' if " " in p and not p.startswith('"') else p)
        return " ".join(out)

    @staticmethod
    def _dork_links(query: str) -> str:
        enc = urllib.parse.quote_plus(query)
        return (
            f"[Google](https://www.google.com/search?q={enc}) · "
            f"[Bing](https://www.bing.com/search?q={enc}) · "
            f"[DuckDuckGo](https://duckduckgo.com/?q={enc})"
        )

    def _searxng(self, query: str) -> list:
        try:
            r = requests.get(
                self.valves.searxng_url.rstrip("/") + "/search",
                params={"q": query, "format": "json", "language": "en-GB"},
                timeout=self.valves.request_timeout,
                headers={"User-Agent": _UA},
            )
            r.raise_for_status()
            data = r.json()
        except Exception:
            return []
        hits = []
        for item in (data.get("results") or [])[: self.valves.results_per_query]:
            hits.append(
                {
                    "title": (item.get("title") or "").strip(),
                    "url": (item.get("url") or "").strip(),
                    "content": (item.get("content") or "").strip()[:200],
                }
            )
        return hits

    def _search_mcpo(self, query: str) -> list:
        """Search via the mcpo web_search route (mcp-searxng). Parses its Title/Description/URL text."""
        if not self.valves.mcpo_api_key:
            return []
        try:
            r = requests.post(
                self.valves.mcpo_url.rstrip("/") + "/web_search/searxng_web_search",
                json={
                    "query": query,
                    "num_results": self.valves.results_per_query,
                    "language": "en-GB",
                    "safesearch": 0,
                    "response_format": "text",
                },
                timeout=self.valves.request_timeout + 8,
                headers={
                    "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.valves.mcpo_api_key}",
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "User-Agent": _UA,
                },
            )
            r.raise_for_status()
            try:
                text = r.json()
            except Exception:
                text = r.text
            if not isinstance(text, str):
                text = str(text)
        except Exception:
            return []
        hits = []
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"Title:\s*(.*?)\s*\nDescription:\s*(.*?)\s*\nURL:\s*(\S+)", text, re.S
        ):
            hits.append(
                {
                    "title": m.group(1).strip(),
                    "content": m.group(2).strip()[:200],
                    "url": m.group(3).strip(),
                }
            )
            if len(hits) >= self.valves.results_per_query:
                break
        return hits

    def _search(self, query: str) -> list:
        """Dispatch: MCP route first (if enabled + key), else direct SearXNG. Tracks which backend served."""
        if self.valves.use_mcpo_search and self.valves.mcpo_api_key:
            hits = self._search_mcpo(query)
            if hits:
                self._last_backend = "mcp"

        hits = self._searxng(query)
        self._last_backend = "direct" if hits else "none"
        return hits

    # Page-reading backends (redundancy chain)

    @staticmethod
    def _strip_html(raw: str) -> str:
        raw = re.sub(r"(?is)<(script|style|noscript|template).*?</\1>", " ", raw)
        raw = re.sub(r"(?s)<[^>]+>", " ", raw)
        raw = _html.unescape(raw)
        return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", raw).strip()

    def _fetch_jina(self, url: str) -> Optional[str]:
        try:
            r = requests.get(
                self.valves.jina_reader_url.rstrip("/") + "/" + url,
                timeout=self.valves.fetch_timeout,
                headers={"User-Agent": _UA, "X-Respond-With": "markdown"},
            )
            r.raise_for_status()
            txt = (r.text or "").strip()
            return txt if len(txt) >= _MIN_CONTENT else None
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _fetch_webfetch(self, url: str) -> Optional[str]:
        if not self.valves.mcpo_api_key:
            return None
        try:
            r = requests.post(
                self.valves.mcpo_url.rstrip("/") + "/web_fetch/fetch",
                json={"url": url},
                timeout=self.valves.fetch_timeout,
                headers={
                    "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.valves.mcpo_api_key}",
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "User-Agent": _UA,
                },
            )
            r.raise_for_status()
            try:
                txt = r.json()
            except Exception:
                txt = r.text
            if isinstance(txt, (dict, list)):
                txt = str(txt)
            txt = (txt or "").strip()
            return txt if len(txt) >= _MIN_CONTENT else None
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _fetch_raw(self, url: str) -> Optional[str]:
        try:
            r = requests.get(
                url,
                timeout=self.valves.fetch_timeout,
                headers={"User-Agent": _UA, "Accept-Language": "en-GB,en;q=0.9"},
            )
            r.raise_for_status()
            txt = self._strip_html(r.text or "")
            return txt if len(txt) >= _MIN_CONTENT else None
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _read_chain(self, url: str):
        for name, fn in (
            ("jina-reader", self._fetch_jina),
        ):
            txt = fn(url)
            if txt:
                return name, txt
        return None, None

    def _mcpo_call(self, route: str, payload: dict):
        """Call a mcpo route (e.g. 'osint/wayback_urls'). Returns parsed JSON or None."""
        if not self.valves.mcpo_api_key:
            return None
        try:
            r = requests.post(
                self.valves.mcpo_url.rstrip("/") + "/" + route.lstrip("/"),
                json=payload,
                timeout=self.valves.fetch_timeout,
                headers={
                    "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.valves.mcpo_api_key}",
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "User-Agent": _UA,
                },
            )
            r.raise_for_status()
            try:
                return r.json()
            except Exception:
                return r.text
        except Exception as e:
            return {"_error": str(e)}

    def _render_section(self, heading: str, queries: list):
        lines = [f"\n### {heading}\n"]
        urls = []
        for label, query in queries:
            lines.append(f"**{label}** — `{query}`")
            if self.valves.use_searxng:
                hits = self._search(query)
                if hits:
                    for h in hits:
                        lines.append(f"- [{h['title'] or '(untitled)'}]({h['url']})")
                        if h["url"]:
                            urls.append(h["url"])
                        if h["content"]:
                            lines.append(f"  - {h['content']}")
                else:
                    lines.append("- _no live hits — try the manual links:_")
            lines.append(f"  - 🔎 {self._dork_links(query)}")
            lines.append("")
        return "\n".join(lines), urls

    async def _run_section(self, heading, queries, status, counter):
        """Verbose section runner: emits per-query status, returns (md, urls, log)."""
        lines = [f"\n### {heading}\n"]
        urls, log = [], []
        for label, query in queries:
            counter["i"] += 1
            hits = self._search(query) if self.valves.use_searxng else []
            backend = self._last_backend if self.valves.use_searxng else "off"
            if self.valves.verbose:
                await status(
                    f"🔎 [{counter['i']}/{counter['n']}] {label} → {len(hits)} hit(s) [{backend}]"
                )
            lines.append(f"**{label}** — `{query}`")
            if self.valves.use_searxng:
                if hits:
                    for h in hits:
                        lines.append(f"- [{h['title'] or '(untitled)'}]({h['url']})")
                        if h["url"]:
                            urls.append(h["url"])
                        if h["content"]:
                            lines.append(f"  - {h['content']}")
                else:
                    lines.append("- _no live hits — try the manual links:_")
            lines.append(f"  - 🔎 {self._dork_links(query)}")
            lines.append("")
            log.append((heading, label, len(hits), backend))
        return "\n".join(lines), urls, log

    t = Tools()

title: Smart Read Aloud
author: setup
version: 1.0.0
description: Reliably narrate pasted/current or previous chat text with local Kokoro. The tool reads text directly from chat history, chunks long documents sequentially, reports progress, retries failed chunks, and returns one MP3.
"""

import asyncio
import html
import inspect
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

def _content_text(content) -> str:
    """Extract only textual chat content from Open WebUI message formats."""
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if not isinstance(content, list):
        return ""
    pieces = []
    for item in content:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        if item.get("type") in ("text", "input_text", "output_text"):
            value = item.get("text", "")
            if isinstance(value, str):
                pieces.append(value)
    return "\n".join(pieces)


def _last_role_text(messages, role: str) -> str:
    for message in reversed(messages or []):
        if isinstance(message, dict) and message.get("role") == role:
            value = _content_text(message.get("content"))
            if value.strip():
                return value.strip()
    return ""


def _strip_read_aloud_invocation(text: str) -> str:
    """Remove the slash-skill/directive from the current user text before narration."""
    value = (text or "").lstrip()
    patterns = (
        r"^(?:<\$?read-aloud(?:\|[^>]+)?>|/read-aloud)\s*[:;,\-–—]*\s*",
        r"^(?:please\s+)?read\s+(?:the\s+following\s+|this\s+)?(?:text\s+)?aloud(?:\s+to\s+me)?\s*[:;,\-–—]*\s*",
        r"^(?:please\s+)?narrate\s+(?:the\s+following\s+|this\s+)?(?:text\s*)?\s*[:;,\-–—]*\s*",
    )
    for pattern in patterns:
        updated = re.sub(pattern, "", value, count=1, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if updated != value:
            value = updated.lstrip()
            break
    return value.strip()


def _previous_response_requested(text: str) -> bool:
    """Recognise requests that refer to existing assistant output rather than pasted prose."""
    value = text or ""
    patterns = (
        r"\b(?:read|narrate)\s+(?:your\s+)?(?:previous|last)\s+(?:answer|response|message|reply)\b",
        r"\b(?:read|narrate)\s+(?:that|it)\s+aloud\b",
        r"\b(?:previous|last)\s+(?:answer|response|message|reply)\s+(?:aloud|as audio)\b",
    )
    return any(re.search(pattern, value, flags=re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in patterns)


def _clean_for_speech(text: str, code_block_policy: str = "omit") -> str:
    """Remove visual Markdown noise while retaining normal prose and pauses."""
    value = html.unescape(text or "")
    if code_block_policy == "read":
        value = re.sub(r"```[^\n]*\n?(.*?)```", r"\n\1\n", value, flags=re.DOTALL)
    else:
        value = re.sub(r"```.*?```", "\nCode block omitted.\n", value, flags=re.DOTALL)
    value = re.sub(r"`([^`]*)`", r"\1", value)
    value = re.sub(r"!\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]*\)", r"\1", value)
    value = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)", r"\1", value)
    value = re.sub(r"<https?://[^>]+>", "", value)
    value = re.sub(r"https?://\S+", "", value)
    value = re.sub(r"^\s{0,3}#{1,6}\s*", "", value, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    value = re.sub(r"^\s*>+\s?", "", value, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    value = re.sub(r"^\s*[-*+]\s+", "", value, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    value = re.sub(r"^\s*\d+[.)]\s+", "", value, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    value = re.sub(r"[*_~]{1,3}([^*_~\n]+)[*_~]{1,3}", r"\1", value)
    value = re.sub(r"\[(?:\^?\d+|citation needed)\]", "", value, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    value = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", value)

    converted_lines = []
    for line in value.splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if re.fullmatch(r"\|?(?:\s*:?-{3,}:?\s*\|)+\s*:?-{3,}:?\s*\|?", stripped):
            continue
        if stripped.count("|") >= 2:
            cells = [cell.strip() for cell in stripped.strip("|").split("|") if cell.strip()]
            line = ". ".join(cells)
        converted_lines.append(line)
    value = "\n".join(converted_lines)

    value = re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", value)
    value = re.sub(r" *\n *", "\n", value)
    value = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", value)
    return value.strip()


def _hard_split(text: str, limit: int) -> list[str]:
    """Split a single overlong sentence on whitespace, with a final hard limit."""
    pieces = []
    current = ""
    for word in text.split():
        if len(word) > limit:
            if current:
                pieces.append(current)
                current = ""
            pieces.extend(word[index : index + limit] for index in range(0, len(word), limit))
            continue
        candidate = f"{current} {word}".strip()
        if current and len(candidate) > limit:
            pieces.append(current)
            current = word
        else:
            current = candidate
    if current:
        pieces.append(current)
    return pieces


def _chunk_text(text: str, limit: int) -> list[str]:
    """Paragraph/sentence-aware splitting that never exceeds the requested limit."""
    if not text:
        return []
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return [text]

    units = []
    for paragraph in re.split(r"\n{2,}", text):
        paragraph = paragraph.strip()
        if not paragraph:
            continue
        if len(paragraph) <= limit:
            units.append(paragraph)
            continue
        sentences = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])(?:[\"'”’)]*)\s+", paragraph)
        for sentence in sentences:
            sentence = sentence.strip()
            if not sentence:
                continue
            units.extend([sentence] if len(sentence) <= limit else _hard_split(sentence, limit))

    chunks = []
    current = ""
    for unit in units:
        separator = "\n\n" if current and ("\n" in unit or unit[:1].isupper()) else " "
        candidate = f"{current}{separator}{unit}".strip()
        if current and len(candidate) > limit:
            chunks.append(current)
            current = unit
        else:
            current = candidate
    if current:
        chunks.append(current)
    return chunks


class Tools:
    class Valves(BaseModel):
        KOKORO_URL: str = Field(
            default="http://kokoro-tts:8880",
            description="Internal URL for the local Kokoro OpenAI-compatible API.",
        )
        VOICE_DEFAULT: KOKORO_VOICE = Field(
            default="af_bella",
            description="Default Kokoro voice. This is a dropdown in the tool Valves.",
        )
        SPEED_DEFAULT: float = Field(
            default=1.0,
            ge=0.5,
            le=2.0,
            description="Default narration speed. 1.0 is natural speed.",
        )
        NORMAL_CHUNK_CHARS: int = Field(
            default=1400,
            ge=500,
            le=3000,
            description="Maximum characters per Kokoro request for ordinary text.",
        )
        LONG_TEXT_THRESHOLD: int = Field(
            default=12000,
            ge=3000,
            description="Text at or above this size uses the smaller long-text chunks.",
        )
        LONG_CHUNK_CHARS: int = Field(
            default=1000,
            ge=400,
            le=2500,
            description="Maximum characters per request for long documents; smaller is safer.",
        )
        MAX_TEXT_CHARS: int = Field(
            default=150000,
            ge=1000,
            description="Hard safety limit after Markdown cleaning. Text is never silently truncated.",
        )
        REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: int = Field(
            default=180,
            ge=30,
            le=900,
            description="Timeout for each individual Kokoro chunk, not the full document.",
        )
        RETRIES_PER_CHUNK: int = Field(
            default=1,
            ge=0,
            le=3,
            description="Retry count for a failed or timed-out chunk.",
        )
        CODE_BLOCK_POLICY: Literal["omit", "read"] = Field(
            default="omit",
            description="Whether fenced code blocks are omitted or read as plain text.",
        )

    def __init__(self):
        self.valves = self.Valves()
        self.citation = False

    async def _status(self, emitter, description: str, done: bool = False):
        if emitter:
            await emitter(
                {
                    "type": "status",
                    "data": {"description": description, "done": done},
                }
            )

    @staticmethod
    async def _disconnected(request) -> bool:
        if request is None or not hasattr(request, "is_disconnected"):
            return False
        try:
            result = request.is_disconnected()
            return bool(await result) if inspect.isawaitable(result) else bool(result)
        except Exception:
            return False

    def _voices(self) -> list[str]:
        endpoint = self.valves.KOKORO_URL.rstrip("/") + "/v1/audio/voices"
        with urllib.request.urlopen(endpoint, timeout=15) as response:
            payload = json.load(response)
        values = payload.get("voices", payload) if isinstance(payload, dict) else payload
        return [str(item.get("id")) if isinstance(item, dict) else str(item) for item in values]

    def _resolve_voice(self, requested: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
        configured = str(self.valves.VOICE_DEFAULT)
        value = (requested or "").strip().lower()
        if not value:
            return configured, ""
        try:
            voices = self._voices()
        except Exception:
            return value, "Voice list was temporarily unavailable; the requested ID was used directly."
        if value in voices:
            return value, ""
        matches = [voice for voice in voices if value in voice.lower()]
        if len(matches) == 1:
            return matches[0], f"Matched '{requested}' to '{matches[0]}'."
        return configured, f"Voice '{requested}' was not found; used Valve default '{configured}'."

    def _tts_to_file(self, text: str, voice: str, speed: float, output_path: str):
        endpoint = self.valves.KOKORO_URL.rstrip("/") + "/v1/audio/speech"
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            endpoint,
            data=json.dumps(
                {
                    "model": "kokoro",
                    "voice": voice,
                    "input": text,
                    "response_format": "mp3",
                    "speed": speed,
                }
            ).encode("utf-8"),
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
            method="POST",
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(
                request, timeout=int(self.valves.REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
            ) as response, open(output_path, "wb") as output:
                while True:
                    block = response.read(1024 * 1024)
                    if not block:
                        break
                    output.write(block)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            detail = exc.read(500).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            raise RuntimeError(f"Kokoro HTTP {exc.code}: {detail}") from exc
        if not os.path.exists(output_path) or os.path.getsize(output_path) < 512:
            raise RuntimeError("Kokoro returned an empty or incomplete MP3 chunk.")

    @staticmethod
    def _concat_mp3(part_paths: list[str], output_path: str):
        if len(part_paths) == 1:
            shutil.copyfile(part_paths[0], output_path)
            return

        workdir = os.path.dirname(output_path)
        list_path = os.path.join(workdir, "parts.txt")
        with open(list_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as listing:
            for part_path in part_paths:
                listing.write(f"file '{Path(part_path).name}'\n")

        common = [
            "ffmpeg",
            "-y",
            "-v",
            "error",
            "-f",
            "concat",
            "-safe",
            "0",
            "-i",
            Path(list_path).name,
            "-map",
            "0:a:0",
        ]
        copy_result = subprocess.run(
            common + ["-c:a", "copy", Path(output_path).name],
            cwd=workdir,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=300,
        )
        if copy_result.returncode == 0 and os.path.getsize(output_path) > 512:
            return

        encode_result = subprocess.run(
            common + ["-c:a", "libmp3lame", "-q:a", "3", Path(output_path).name],
            cwd=workdir,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=600,
        )
        if encode_result.returncode != 0 or not os.path.exists(output_path):
            detail = (encode_result.stderr or copy_result.stderr or "unknown ffmpeg failure").strip()
            raise RuntimeError(f"Could not join the MP3 chunks: {detail[-800:]}")

    async def _save_owui_file(self, source_path: str, filename: str, user_id: str | None) -> str:
        """Publish through OWUI's file API; never return an unserved cache path."""
        if not user_id:
            raise RuntimeError("Open WebUI did not supply a user ID for the generated file.")

        errors = []
        for attempt in range(2):
            stored_path = None
            record = None
            try:
                from open_webui.models.files import FileForm, Files
                from open_webui.storage.provider import Storage

                file_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                with open(source_path, "rb") as source:
                    try:
                        _, stored_path = Storage.upload_file(
                            source, f"{file_id}_{filename}", tags={}
                        )
                    except TypeError:
                        source.seek(0)
                        _, stored_path = Storage.upload_file(source, f"{file_id}_{filename}")
                record = Files.insert_new_file(
                    user_id,
                    FileForm(
                        id=file_id,
                        filename=filename,
                        path=stored_path,
                        meta={
                            "name": filename,
                            "content_type": "audio/mpeg",
                            "size": os.path.getsize(source_path),
                        },
                    ),
                )
                if inspect.isawaitable(record):
                    record = await record
                if record is not None:
                    return f"/api/v1/files/{file_id}/content"
                errors.append(f"attempt {attempt + 1}: file database returned no record")
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(f"attempt {attempt + 1}: {exc}")
            if stored_path and record is None:
                try:
                    os.remove(stored_path)
                except OSError:
                    pass
            if attempt == 0:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.25)

        raise RuntimeError("Open WebUI file storage failed; " + " | ".join(errors))

    async def read_aloud(
        self,
        voice: str = "",
        speed: float = 0.0,
        title: str = "",
        __event_emitter__=None,
        __messages__=None,
        __user__=None,
        __request__=None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Read chat text aloud with local Kokoro and return one playable/downloadable MP3.

        The source text is always fetched directly from chat history. Pasted content after
        /read-aloud is narrated; if the current message only invokes the skill or refers to
        the previous/last answer, the previous assistant response is narrated. The calling
        model must never copy the document or choose its source.

        :param voice: Optional Kokoro voice ID/partial name. Empty uses the VOICE_DEFAULT Valve.
        :param speed: Optional speed from 0.5 to 2.0. Zero uses the SPEED_DEFAULT Valve.
        :param title: Optional short filename title. Do not copy document content here.
        """
        raw_last_user = _last_role_text(__messages__, "user")
        last_user = _strip_read_aloud_invocation(raw_last_user)
        last_assistant = _last_role_text(__messages__, "assistant")

        if _previous_response_requested(raw_last_user) or not last_user:
            selected = last_assistant
            selected_source = "previous assistant response"
        else:
            selected = last_user
            selected_source = "current user message"

        if not selected.strip():
            return (
                "No text was found. Paste text after /read-aloud, or invoke it after an "
                "assistant response to narrate that response."
            )

        cleaned = _clean_for_speech(selected, str(self.valves.CODE_BLOCK_POLICY))
        if not cleaned:
            return "The selected content contained no speakable text after Markdown cleaning."
        if len(cleaned) > int(self.valves.MAX_TEXT_CHARS):
            return (
                f"The cleaned text is {len(cleaned):,} characters, above the "
                f"MAX_TEXT_CHARS Valve ({int(self.valves.MAX_TEXT_CHARS):,}). Nothing was "
                "truncated or generated. Raise that Valve deliberately or split the text."
            )

        chunk_limit = (
            int(self.valves.LONG_CHUNK_CHARS)
            if len(cleaned) >= int(self.valves.LONG_TEXT_THRESHOLD)
            else int(self.valves.NORMAL_CHUNK_CHARS)
        )
        chunks = _chunk_text(cleaned, chunk_limit)
        resolved_voice, voice_note = await asyncio.to_thread(self._resolve_voice, voice)
        resolved_speed = (
            float(speed) if speed and float(speed) > 0 else float(self.valves.SPEED_DEFAULT)
        )
        resolved_speed = max(0.5, min(2.0, resolved_speed))
        words = len(re.findall(r"\b\w+\b", cleaned))
        estimated_minutes = words / (150.0 * resolved_speed) if words else 0.0

        await self._status(
            __event_emitter__,
            f"Preparing {words:,} words from the {selected_source}: {len(chunks)} sequential "
            f"Kokoro part{'s' if len(chunks) != 1 else ''}, about {estimated_minutes:.1f} minutes of audio.",
        )

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="smart_read_aloud_") as workdir:
            part_paths = []
            for index, chunk in enumerate(chunks, start=1):
                if await self._disconnected(__request__):
                    await self._status(
                        __event_emitter__,
                        f"Stopped after part {index - 1}/{len(chunks)} because the chat disconnected.",
                        True,
                    )
                    return "Audio generation stopped because the client disconnected. No partial file was published."

                percent = round((index - 1) * 100 / len(chunks))
                await self._status(
                    __event_emitter__,
                    f"🎙️ Part {index}/{len(chunks)} ({percent}%) with {resolved_voice}…",
                )
                part_path = os.path.join(workdir, f"part_{index:04d}.mp3")
                attempts = int(self.valves.RETRIES_PER_CHUNK) + 1
                for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):
                    try:
                        await asyncio.to_thread(
                            self._tts_to_file,
                            chunk,
                            resolved_voice,
                            resolved_speed,
                            part_path,
                        )
                        break
                    except Exception as exc:
                        if attempt >= attempts:
                            await self._status(
                                __event_emitter__,
                                f"Part {index}/{len(chunks)} failed after {attempts} attempt(s): {exc}",
                                True,
                            )
                            return (
                                f"Audio generation failed at part {index}/{len(chunks)}: {exc}. "
                                "Earlier temporary chunks were cleaned up and no incomplete MP3 was published."
                            )
                        await self._status(
                            __event_emitter__,
                            f"Part {index}/{len(chunks)} failed ({exc}); retrying once…",
                        )
                        await asyncio.sleep(0.75)
                part_paths.append(part_path)

            await self._status(__event_emitter__, "Joining the completed Kokoro parts into one MP3…")
            final_path = os.path.join(workdir, "smart_read_aloud.mp3")
            try:
                await asyncio.to_thread(self._concat_mp3, part_paths, final_path)
            except Exception as exc:
                await self._status(__event_emitter__, f"MP3 assembly failed: {exc}", True)
                return f"All speech parts were generated, but MP3 assembly failed: {exc}"

            safe_title = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", (title or "").strip()).strip("._-")
            filename = f"{safe_title or 'read_aloud'}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}.mp3"
            user_id = (__user__ or {}).get("id") if isinstance(__user__, dict) else None
            try:
                file_url = await self._save_owui_file(final_path, filename, user_id)
            except Exception as exc:
                await self._status(__event_emitter__, f"Could not publish the final MP3: {exc}", True)
                return f"Speech was generated, but the final MP3 could not be saved: {exc}"
            size_bytes = os.path.getsize(final_path)

        note_html = f"<div>{html.escape(voice_note)}</div>" if voice_note else ""
        player = (
            '<div style="max-width:720px">'
            f'<audio controls preload="metadata" style="width:100%" src="{html.escape(file_url, quote=True)}"></audio>'
            f'<div style="margin-top:6px"><a href="{html.escape(file_url, quote=True)}" download="{html.escape(filename, quote=True)}">'
            f"⬇️ Download {html.escape(filename)}</a></div>"
            f"<div style=\"margin-top:4px;opacity:.75\">{words:,} words · {len(chunks)} part{'s' if len(chunks) != 1 else ''} · "
            f"{estimated_minutes:.1f} min estimated · {html.escape(resolved_voice)} at {resolved_speed:g}× · {size_bytes / (1024 * 1024):.1f} MB</div>"
