content:
"""
title: Windows PowerShell
author: Liam Rooney
version: 1.0.0
license: MIT
description: Runs Windows PowerShell only after an interactive Open WebUI popup lets the administrator choose Read, Read/Write, or Read/Write Elevated for that individual call. Background calls are refused; elevation also requires Windows UAC.
requirements: requests
"""

import asyncio
import json
import os
from typing import Any, Callable, Literal, Optional

import requests
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


ACCESS_LABELS = {
    "Read": "read",
    "Read/Write": "read_write",
    "Read/Write Elevated": "read_write_elevated",
}
REQUEST_LABELS = {
    "read": "Read",
    "read_write": "Read/Write",
    "read_write_elevated": "Read/Write Elevated",
}


class Tools:
    class Valves(BaseModel):
        BROKER_URL: str = Field(
            default="http://{{PC_TS_IP}}:18110",
            description="Windows broker URL as reached from the Open WebUI container. Keep it on the PC Tailscale address, never localhost or 0.0.0.0.",
        )
        TIMEOUT_PADDING_SECONDS: int = Field(default=75, ge=30, le=180)
        COMMAND_PREVIEW_CHARS: int = Field(default=3000, ge=500, le=8000)

    def __init__(self):
        self.valves = self.Valves()
        self.citation = False

    async def _say(self, emitter: Optional[Callable], message: str, done: bool = False) -> None:
        if emitter:
            await emitter({"type": "status", "data": {"description": message, "done": done}})

    @staticmethod
    def _normalise_requested(value: str) -> str:
        candidate = (value or "").strip().lower().replace("/", "_").replace(" ", "_")
        aliases = {
            "read": "read",
            "read_only": "read",
            "read_write": "read_write",
            "readwrite": "read_write",
            "read_write_elevated": "read_write_elevated",
            "elevated": "read_write_elevated",
            "admin": "read_write_elevated",
        }
        return aliases.get(candidate, "read")

    def _call(self, payload: dict[str, Any], token: str, timeout_seconds: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
        response = requests.post(
            f"{self.valves.BROKER_URL.rstrip('/')}/execute",
            json=payload,
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Accept": "application/json"},
            timeout=timeout_seconds + self.valves.TIMEOUT_PADDING_SECONDS,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        data = response.json()
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data.get("status"):
            raise ValueError("broker returned an untyped response")
        return data

    @staticmethod
    def _render(data: dict[str, Any], selected_label: str, requested_label: str) -> str:
        status = str(data.get("status") or "unknown").upper()
        lines = [
            f"[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: {status}]",
            "",
            f"**Selected in popup:** `{selected_label}`  ",
            f"**Model requested:** `{requested_label}`  ",
            f"**Working directory:** `{data.get('working_directory') or 'not executed'}`  ",
            f"**Request ID:** `{data.get('request_id') or 'none'}`",
        ]
        if data.get("message"):
            lines.extend(["", str(data["message"])])
        reasons = data.get("policy_reasons") or []
        if reasons:
            lines.extend(["", "**Read policy reasons:**"])
            lines.extend(f"- {reason}" for reason in reasons)
        if "exit_code" in data:
            lines.extend(["", f"**Exit code:** `{data.get('exit_code')}` · **duration:** `{data.get('duration_ms', '?')} ms`"])
        if data.get("output_truncated"):
            lines.extend(["", "_Output reached the configured cap and was truncated._"])
        stdout = str(data.get("stdout") or "")
        stderr = str(data.get("stderr") or "")
        if stdout:
            lines.extend(["", "## Standard output", "", "```text", stdout.rstrip(), "```"])
        if stderr:
            lines.extend(["", "## Error output", "", "```text", stderr.rstrip(), "```"])
        return "\n".join(lines)

    async def run_powershell(
        self,
        command: str,
        reason: str,
        requested_access: Literal["read", "read_write", "read_write_elevated"] = "read",
        working_directory: str = "",
        timeout_seconds: int = 60,
        __event_call__: Optional[Callable] = None,
        __event_emitter__: Optional[Callable] = None,
        __user__: Optional[dict] = None,
        __chat_id__: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Run PowerShell on Liam's Windows PC only after Liam chooses the actual access level in an Open WebUI popup.

        You MUST put the least access level you believe the command needs in requested_access and explain why in reason. The popup, not you, makes the final decision. Never claim that a command ran until this function returns its real output.

        Access meanings:
        - read: PowerShell read cmdlets only. Mutating verbs, assignments, redirection, method invocation, scripts and native executables are rejected.
        - read_write: arbitrary PowerShell as the normal non-elevated Windows user.
        - read_write_elevated: arbitrary PowerShell through one-call Windows UAC. Request this only when administrator rights are genuinely required.

        :param command: Exact PowerShell to run. Do not include passwords, tokens or other secrets.
        :param reason: Short, concrete explanation of what the command does and why the requested access is required; shown in the popup and audit log.
        :param requested_access: read, read_write, or read_write_elevated. This request is shown to Liam but does not bypass the popup.
        :param working_directory: Optional existing absolute Windows directory. Blank uses E:\\ai\\OpenFolders\\workspace.
        :param timeout_seconds: Command limit in seconds, 1-300. The broker enforces the final cap.
        """
        user = __user__ or {}
        if str(user.get("role") or "").lower() != "admin":
            return "[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: DENIED]\n\nThis host-level tool is restricted to an Open WebUI administrator."
        if not __event_call__:
            return (
                "[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: APPROVAL REQUIRED]\n\n"
                "No interactive Open WebUI popup is available in this execution context. "
                "Background jobs and sub-agents cannot run Windows commands. Ask the user to run this from a normal foreground chat."
            )
        token = os.environ.get("WINDOWS_POWERSHELL_TOOL_TOKEN", "").strip()
        if not token:
            return "[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: UNAVAILABLE]\n\nThe broker token is not present in the Open WebUI environment."
        if not (command or "").strip():
            return "[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: INVALID REQUEST]\n\nThe command is empty."
        if not (reason or "").strip():
            return "[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: INVALID REQUEST]\n\nThe model must state a reason before the popup is shown."

        requested = self._normalise_requested(requested_access)
        requested_label = REQUEST_LABELS[requested]
        preview = command[: self.valves.COMMAND_PREVIEW_CHARS].replace("```", "` ` `")
        if len(command) > self.valves.COMMAND_PREVIEW_CHARS:
            preview += "\n[preview truncated]"
        displayed_working_directory = working_directory or "E:\\ai\\OpenFolders\\workspace"
        message = (
            f"The model requested: {requested_label}\n\n"
            f"Reason: {reason[:1000]}\n\n"
            f"Working directory: {displayed_working_directory}\n"
            f"Timeout: {max(1, min(int(timeout_seconds), 300))} seconds\n\n"
            "Command:\n```powershell\n" + preview + "\n```\n\n"
            "Choose the actual permission for this one call. Closing the popup cancels it. "
            "Elevated also triggers Windows UAC on the PC."
        )
        choice = await __event_call__({
            "type": "input",
            "data": {
                "title": "Windows PowerShell permission",
                "message": message,
                "input": {"type": "select", "options": list(ACCESS_LABELS)},
            },
        })
        if choice is False or choice is None:
            return "[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: CANCELLED]\n\nThe popup was closed or cancelled. No command ran."
        selected_label = str(choice.get("value") if isinstance(choice, dict) else choice)
        selected_mode = ACCESS_LABELS.get(selected_label)
        if selected_mode is None:
            return "[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: CANCELLED]\n\nThe popup returned no recognised access level. No command ran."
        if selected_mode == "read_write_elevated" and requested != "read_write_elevated":
            return (
                "[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: ELEVATION NOT REQUESTED]\n\n"
                "No command ran. Elevated access can execute only when the model explicitly sets "
                "`requested_access` to `read_write_elevated` and states why. Ask the model to make a fresh "
                "call; the new request and reason will be shown in another three-choice popup."
            )

        await self._say(__event_emitter__, f"Windows PowerShell: {selected_label} selected; executing..." if selected_mode != "read_write_elevated" else "Windows PowerShell: waiting for Windows UAC on the PC...")
        payload = {
            "command": command,
            "reason": reason,
            "requested_access": requested,
            "mode": selected_mode,
            "working_directory": working_directory,
            "timeout_seconds": max(1, min(int(timeout_seconds), 300)),
            "caller": f"user={user.get('id', 'unknown')};chat={__chat_id__ or 'unknown'}",
        }
        try:
            data = await asyncio.to_thread(self._call, payload, token, payload["timeout_seconds"])
        except requests.Timeout:
            await self._say(__event_emitter__, "Windows PowerShell broker timed out.", done=True)
            return "[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: BROKER TIMEOUT]\n\nThe Windows broker did not answer before the client timeout."
        except requests.RequestException as exc:
            await self._say(__event_emitter__, "Windows PowerShell broker is unreachable.", done=True)
            return f"[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: BROKER ERROR]\n\n{type(exc).__name__}. No fallback was attempted."
        except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
            await self._say(__event_emitter__, "Windows PowerShell broker returned an invalid response.", done=True)
            return f"[WINDOWS POWERSHELL: BROKER ERROR]\n\n{type(exc).__name__}."
        await self._say(__event_emitter__, f"Windows PowerShell: {data.get('status', 'finished')}", done=True)
        return self._render(data, selected_label, requested_label)
